entries.title: Local Claude SDK client configuration and private bridge credentials
entries.what: Read a dedicated local-bridge configuration and credential without importing Claude OAuth state or allowing a remote endpoint to receive the bridge token.
entries.interfaces: BridgeClientConfig = {version:1, baseUrl:string, tokenFile:string, models:string[]}. Production extension path is <getAgentDir()>/claude-sdk.json. Private-file metadata limit is 65536 bytes; token grammar is /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/. No new environment variable or default bridge port exists here. Both configuration and token are inputs only; this module writes neither file.

entries.title: Claude SDK extension registration, model catalog and status command
entries.what: Expose the local bridge as an optional claude-sdk provider with an explicit status command and externally managed billing labels, while leaving tool execution in the existing agent.
entries.interfaces: Provider id and API string claude-sdk; command /claude-sdk-status; lifecycle event session_shutdown; GET /api/services/claude-sdk/status response {authentication:{state,ready}}. Registration marker apiKey is credential-managed-by-local-claude-sdk-bridge, not a real credential. Model metadata constants are stated above. Status has a 12000 ms abort signal and uses info notifications.

entries.title: Experimental remote command parsing and native connect-mode boundary
entries.what: Preserve the new, explicitly experimental Unix-address command parser without confusing its injected actions with an already wired production server, or with Rust's TCP --connect interception.
entries.interfaces: NamedCommandInvocation; Command.parse/execute; {ok:true,command}|{ok:false,errors}; AuthInput token/file; TransportAddress {transport:'unix',path}; injected ExperimentalCliContext. CLI option values and parser diagnostic order are observable.

entries.title: Custom tool stateful rendering and ANSI-to-HTML conversion
entries.what: Reuse a tool's terminal renderer to produce collapsed and expanded HTML while preserving its per-call render state, style spans and intentional whitespace.
entries.interfaces: ToolHtmlRenderer.renderCall(id,name,args)→string|undefined; renderResult(id,name,content,details,isError)→{collapsed?,expanded?}|undefined. ToolHtmlRendererDeps {getToolDefinition,theme,cwd,width=100}. RenderedToolHtml {callHtml?,resultHtmlCollapsed?,resultHtmlExpanded?}. ansiToHtml and ansiLinesToHtml preserve the stated SGR/whitespace subset.

entries.title: Built-in llama provider login, environment resolution and catalog publication
entries.what: Expose loaded llama.cpp router models through the ordinary provider/model interfaces, with optional API-key login and cached catalog restoration. Configuring a compatible inference URL alone does not reproduce this provider's discovery and auth rules.
entries.interfaces: Provider/API llama.cpp/openai-completions; default router http://127.0.0.1:8080; environment LLAMA_BASE_URL,LLAMA_API_KEY; optional api_key credential with env.LLAMA_BASE_URL; getModels,refreshModels,stream,streamSimple; LlamaProviderController.setCatalog. Login is the generic /login llama.cpp flow, not a /llama login subcommand.

entries.title: Llama router requests, SSE progress and load/download completion
entries.what: Control an already running llama.cpp router and determine when model load, unload and download operations finish. OpenAI-compatible inference alone does not implement this management protocol.
entries.interfaces: LlamaClient(serverUrl,apiKey?); list({reload?,signal?}), load/unload/download(model,signal?), unloadAndWait, loadAndWait(model,onProgress,signal?), downloadAndWait; watch(onEvent,signal?). Management endpoints GET /models[?reload=1], POST /models/load, POST /models/unload, POST /models, GET /models/sse. LlamaProgress {message,ratio?,detail?}.

entries.title: Interactive llama model manager, search and cancellation recovery
entries.what: Provide an interactive model manager that can inspect the router, choose load/unload behavior, search and download GGUF models, and recover previously loaded models when a replacement is cancelled.
entries.interfaces: Command /llama (TUI only; args ignored); /login llama.cpp uses the generic auth flow. UI methods showModels/select/confirm/connectionError/searchModels/showStatus/progress/updateProgress. Action union model|download|close. Selection keys tui.select.up/down/confirm/cancel, search debounce500ms, minimum2 chars, visible10/12 rows, progress width40.
